title: Conformer: Convolution-augmented Transformer for Speech Recognition
problem: Transformer models are good at capturing content-based global interactions, while CNNs exploit local features effectively.
However, models with self-attention or convolutions each has its limitations.
While Transformers are good at modeling long-range global context, they are less capable to extract fine-grained local feature patterns.
One limitation of using local connectivity is that you need many more layers or parameters to capture global information.
However, it is still limited in capturing dynamic global context as it only applies a global averaging over the entire sequence.
core_techniques: [2.1] multi-headed self-attention (MHSA) | 다중 헤드 자기어텐션 모듈을 사용한다.
[2.1] relative sinusoidal positional encoding scheme | 상대적 사인파 위치 인코딩을 사용해 길이 일반화와 강건성을 높인다.
[2.1] pre-norm residual units | 잔차 유닛 내부에 사전 정규화를 적용한다.
[2.2] a pointwise convolution and a gated linear unit (GLU) | 포인트와이즈 합성곱과 GLU 게이팅으로 시작하는 합성곱 모듈이다.
[2.2] single 1-D depthwise convolution layer | 지역 문맥 포착을 위한 1차원 depthwise convolution을 사용한다.
[2.2] Batchnorm | 깊은 모델 학습을 돕기 위해 합성곱 뒤에 배치정규화를 둔다.
[2.3] Swish activation | 피드포워드 모듈에서 Swish 활성화를 사용한다.
[2.4] two Feed Forward modules sandwiching the Multi-Headed Self-Attention module and the Convolution module | 어텐션과 합성곱 모듈을 두 개의 FFN이 감싸는 샌드위치 구조를 사용한다.
[2.4] Macaron-Net | Macaron-Net에서 영감을 받은 이중 FFN 구조를 사용한다.
[2.4] half-step residual weights | FFN 모듈에 half-step residual을 적용한다.
[3.1] SpecAugment | 입력 음성 특징에 데이터 증강을 적용한다.
[3.2] shallow fusion | 외부 언어모델과의 얕은 결합으로 성능을 높인다.

contributions: [1] we propose the convolution-augmented transformer for speech recognition, named Conformer. [1] Conformer significantly outperforms the previous Transformer and CNN based models achieving state-of-the-art accuracies. [1] On the widely used LibriSpeech benchmark, our model achieves WER of 2.1%/4.3% without using a language model and 1.9%/3.9% with an external language model on test/testother. [1] We also observe competitive performance of 2.7%/6.3% with a small model of only 10M parameters. [1] We further carefully study the effects of the number of attention heads, convolution kernel sizes, activation functions, placement of feed-forward layers, and different strategies of adding convolution modules to a Transformer-based network, and shed light on how each contributes to the accuracy improvements.
